translated_title: “They Want to Erase Us From the Digital Cloud”: Mixtec Engineer Asks Deputies to Use AI to Preserve Indigenous Languages
original_title: “Nos quieren borrar de la nube digital”: ingeniero mixteco pide a diputados usar IA para preservar lenguas indígenas
author: Iván Evair Saldaña and Enrique Méndez
meta_description: Speaking in tu'un savi from the Congress tribune, Moisés Hilario López proposed living digital archives of native tongues and AI trained on elders' voices.
